prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: sideswipe while changing lanes in Sugar Land, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported neck and back strain. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1340; do not mention it.)
text:
On arrival, the officer observed two vehicles stopped in the right-hand lane of southbound Highway 6 in Sugar Land, Texas, with visible contact damage to the left rear quarter panel of Vehicle 1 and the right front fender of Vehicle 2. Traffic conditions were clear and the road surface was dry at the time of the collision.

Driver 1 stated that they were attempting to move from the center lane into the right lane when Vehicle 2 entered the same space, resulting in a sideswipe. Driver 2 stated that Vehicle 1 changed lanes without signaling and without checking the blind spot. A Passenger in Vehicle 2 was not injured and declined medical attention.

Driver 1 reported pain in the neck and lower back following the impact and was transported by EMS to a local hospital for evaluation. No airbag deployment was observed in either vehicle. Both vehicles were drivable and were moved to the shoulder before the report was completed.

Based on witness statements and driver accounts, the primary contributing factor appears to be an unsafe lane change by Driver 2. Citation issued to Driver 2 for failure to maintain a single lane. Exchange of insurance information completed at the scene.
